title: Suddhakam
text: 1. Sāvatthinidānam || || 2. Cattāro me bhikkhave satipaṭṭhānā || katame cattāro || || 3. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpi sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || [page 174] 174 Satipaṭṭhāna-Saṃyuttam XLVII. Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro satipaṭṭhānā ti || ||
